QuestInfo.name: South Sanctum Patrol
QuestInfo.0: This fellow Anor guarding the North Sanctum doesn't seem too reliable. Is it okay for you to leave this place to him? Discuss the matter with Eskalade.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the #bSouth Sanctum#k as Eskalade said and check the condition of the Sacred Stone.
QuestInfo.2: You met Priestess Christina guarding the South Sanctum. She told you to take refuge as the sanctum was threatened. Fortunately, Kyle arrived first and the Sacred Stone wasn't taken.
